name: After § 23
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 23a. Notes that fact-checking, while an important instrument to counter disinformation, can itself be misused or perceived to be a tool for manipulation if it lacks transparency, pluralism, demonstrable expertise or clear accountability; stresses therefore the need for robust safeguards, including full transparency regarding funding sources, methodologies and governance structures, strict separation from political or commercial interests, the possibility of peer review and reasoned contestation of assessments, and appropriate independent oversight mechanisms;
